scope: Historical evidence review retained after the bounded current Super Dragon aggregate integration.

sources.title: Clash of Clans Winter 2021
sources.finding: Launch table establishes any-target priority, ground-and-air targets, area splash, housing 40, movement speed 14, and launch levels 7–9 DPS/HP.

sources.title: Home Village Balance Changes
sources.finding: Level 8/9 DPS changed to 405/429 and attack range was reduced by 0.5 tiles; the resulting absolute range and Roast cadence/geometry are not published.

sources.title: Super Dragon — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.finding: Dated client-file rendering reports Home Village range 3, attack speed 1.8 s, all 11 current levels, and level-11 HP/DPS 8400/537.

sources.title: Pinned normalized Dragon superTroop payload
sources.finding: Pinned payload has range 3, damage-per-shot and DPS, but exports attack_speed_seconds 0.192 and no damage radius, burst count, projectile or target-selection contract.

established: Super Dragon is an in-scope flying Home Village Super Troop with any-target, ground-and-air area-splash behavior, housing space 40 and base movement speed 14.
The current secondary dated-build page corroborates range 3 and a 1.8-second attack speed, while the immutable catalogue retains its per-level provenance.
The public official balance history proves that range and DPS changed after launch, so launch values cannot be silently reused as current values.
unresolved: The pinned 0.192-second field conflicts with the dated-build 1.8-second attack speed; no source explains whether it is a burst sub-interval, animation value, or importer-unit mismatch.
No source provides damage radius, burst shot count, damage allocation across a burst, splash target eligibility, target selection, target-loss behavior, projectile travel or T+ms impact ordering.
No source gives collision geometry, altitude boundary for area victims, size-aware attack edge measurement, sprite placement, range-overlay measurement or animation timing.
decision: Superseded by th18-2026-09-18-super-dragon.json: the dated 1.8-second aggregate cycle is now shared through Core, GUI and RL for the primary target only. Do not claim Roasted splash fidelity or enable unsourced secondary victims until a version-identified radius, burst and timing contract exists.
